sql_log.purpose: Test separation-of-duty fields in pre-cut run rows without equating distinct labels to material independence.
sql_log.sql:
select
 count(*) as runs,
 count(*) filter (where curator_identity is null) as curator_identity_null,
 count(*) filter (where validator_identity is null) as validator_identity_null,
 count(*) filter (where curator_identity is not null and validator_identity is not null and curator_identity=validator_identity) as same_identity,
 count(*) filter (where curator_identity is distinct from validator_identity) as distinct_identity,
 count(*) filter (where curator_component_id is null) as curator_component_null,
 count(*) filter (where validator_component_id is null) as validator_component_null,
 count(*) filter (where curator_component_id is not null and validator_component_id is not null and curator_component_id=validator_component_id) as same_component,
 count(*) filter (where curator_component_id is distinct from validator_component_id) as distinct_component,
 count(distinct (curator_identity,validator_identity)) as identity_pairs,
 count(distinct (curator_component_id,validator_component_id)) as component_pairs
from programacion.input_readiness_runs
where created_at < timestamptz '2026-10-15 00:00:00+00'
